notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR9: a reference to an operand "as a qualifier does not constitute reference to that item for the debugging". DebugTriggerPlanner.Plan/Find match a statement's resolved item references, so a qualifier is never a hit; AlterSwitchEmitter.EmitDebugTriggers fires for the altered paragraph, not for a section that qualifies it; and since PB5414 a section subject fires only when control enters the section from outside (AddDebugSectionSubject's SubjectEndPc), so a qualified reference to a later paragraph runs nothing. Probed at 85 (classes b, d, e): USE ON G: MOVE TO G1 OF G and MOVE TO G1 IN H run nothing, MOVE TO G runs [28][G][X]; USE ON F: OPEN and CLOSE run, MOVE TO FK IN FR IN F does not; USE ON S2: ALTER PX OF S1 TO PROCEED TO Q2 OF S2, PERFORM Q2 OF S2 and the altered GO TO into Q2 OF S2 run nothing; ALTER QX OF S2 runs nothing for S2 and the later fall-through into S2 runs it with FALL THROUGH. A GO TO Q1 OF S2 to the first paragraph from outside runs S2 as execution of the section (GR3 a, docs/conformance/3/D-DEBUG-PROCEDURE), not as a reference. The witness matches. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read DIVERGES, naming kb/Work PB5083 (landed), kb/Work PB5414 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5414 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-01.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-01-refute.json).
